_comment: Connector manifests. Built-in connectors (filesystem, web) are implemented in engine/src/connectors and registered at boot. Entries marked planned are roadmap gates: the framework exists; they ship with their own OAuth/security review.

filesystem.scope: hard-scoped to each objective's workspace folder; writes outside are on the no-go map

web.scope: HTTP GET only; allow-listed domains are tier A, anything else raises a tier-C approval gate; private address ranges are blocked

gdocs.note: Google Docs/Drive via OAuth — requires your own OAuth client credentials; lands as a versioned connector with mocked Testing-mode writes.

embodiment.note: Mouse/keyboard control (the Python embodiment cluster in reference/). Stays dry-run and unwired until the Phase-3 security review; see SECURITY.md.
